verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents version management for its Transformations, the in-flight automation logic: you can save drafts, publish versions, and redeploy older versions, which covers versioning and rollback. Pre-deploy review is supported through test cases, testing against sample events, and audit logs, and Profiles are defined in version-controlled YAML. This coverage is limited to transformations and profiles, and each point rests on a single brief line. Missing for 10: versioning/rollback for pipelines, connections and Reverse ETL configurations; documented diff or approval-based review workflow; in-depth docs on the rollback mechanics; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
